sources.title: Qwen3.5-397B-A17B model card
sources.evidence: Post-trained vision-language checkpoint; language model is nominally 397B total/17B active. Documents native context, thinking, image/video input and tools.

sources.title: Official checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration; 60 decoder layers, alternating three linear-attention layers with one full-attention layer; 512 routed experts, 10 selected, shared expert, vision encoder and one MTP layer.

sources.title: Official repository metadata and Safetensors parameter count
sources.evidence: Safetensors total 403397928944: BF16 403397920304 plus F32 8640. Repository created 2026-02-16T04:55:12Z; creation alone does not establish public availability.

sources.title: Official checkpoint tensor index
sources.evidence: Contains model.language_model, model.visual, lm_head and mtp tensor namespaces; the checkpoint total includes visual and MTP components.

sources.title: Official Qwen repository release history
sources.evidence: Qwen3.5 repository redirects here. News explicitly dates first 397B-A17B MoE release February 16, 2026 and links official weights.

sources.title: Alibaba Open-Sources Qwen3.5, A Natively Multimodal Model Built For High-Efficiency Inference
sources.evidence: February 16, 2026 announcement explicitly releases Qwen3.5-397B-A17B open weights; separately mentions API access. Confirms Alibaba, Qwen family, and text/image/video input with text output.

sources.title: Qwen3.5: Towards Native Multimodal Agents
sources.evidence: Indexed primary-page text announces open-weight release and is stamped 2026/02/15, conflicting with official repository and Alibaba February 16 dates. Direct page extraction returned no text; evidence is the search-indexed page.

name.note: Display spacing matches the official checkpoint identifier and model-card title.

developer.note: Developed by the Qwen team at Alibaba.

family.note: Alibaba announcement identifies this checkpoint as the first Qwen3.5 model.

release_date.note: Explicit first-release date in official repository and corporate announcement; indexed Qwen blog says February 15. Prefer the two explicit release records; API availability is separate.

open_weights.note: Official repository distributes checkpoint weights; release announcement explicitly confirms their release.

license.note: Official checkpoint license file specifies Apache License 2.0.

parameters_b.note: Full stored checkpoint: 403397928944 parameters / 1e9, including visual and MTP tensors. The card separately labels the language model 397B; that nominal count is not the full stored checkpoint.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal language-decoder active count; does not include an asserted visual/MTP activation count.

architecture.note: Hybrid Gated DeltaNet/full-attention MoE decoder with vision encoder; 10 of 512 routed experts plus shared expert.

context_window.note: Native context; the card separately describes extension to 1010000.

modalities.note: Alibaba explicitly lists text, image and video processing with text generation.

reasoning.note: Thinking enabled by default; non-thinking mode supported.

tool_call.note: Exact-model serving examples enable tool parsing.

description.value: Open-weight Qwen vision-language MoE combining Gated DeltaNet and full attention, with thinking and tool calling.
description.note: Replace broad intended-use language with documented capabilities.

patch.description: Open-weight Qwen vision-language MoE combining Gated DeltaNet and full attention, with thinking and tool calling.
patch.notes: Full checkpoint contains 403.397928944B stored parameters including vision and MTP tensors; 397B total and 17B active are nominal language-decoder figures. Native context is 262144 tokens. Official repository and Alibaba date the first release February 16, 2026; the indexed Qwen blog displays February 15.
patch.name: Qwen3.5 397B-A17B

summary: Correct full checkpoint total to 403.397928944B; retain nominal 397B language-decoder component and 17B active decoder count with explicit scope. Add Apache-2.0 and precise hybrid-architecture description. Prefer February 16 release based on two explicit primary release records; preserve the indexed blog date conflict.
